links.outcome: Effect of confidence estimation methods on stability of gradient-based explanations
links.effect: MCD often adversely affects model gradients, while MCBN does not. Many participant-level differences were found between regular explanations and explanation distributions from combined approaches.
links.quote: We find that MCD often adversely affects model gradients, making it ill-suited for integration with gradient-based explainability methods.

unlisted_practices: Integrating confidence estimation (MC dropout, MC batch normalization) with gradient-based explainability methods in neuroimaging classifiers

screen.reason: Evaluates technical safety/transparency safeguards (combining confidence estimation methods like MCD/MCBN with gradient-based explainability methods) for neuroimaging diagnostic AI.

primary.practice: integration of confidence estimation with explainability
